headline: Bitcoin Options Skew Jumps To 5.09 From 3.88 Ahead Of The October 22 Expiry
narrative: Bitcoin options skew rose to 5.09 volatility points from 3.88, which means the October 22 put struck at 76,000 is priced 5.09 points above the October 22 call struck at 91,000. That wider gap means money is paying more for downside protection into the expiry than on the prior print, when the same strikes carried a 3.88 point premium. Bitcoin implied volatility printed 37.28, from 37.4, at the 61.3 percentile of the past 30 days, which means the pipe for expected swings sits at that reading while the new money is in the put-over-call gap.
author: jordan
